items.docs: Returns the full documentation index with feature taxonomy, section outlines, and descriptions as markdown.

params.name: features
params.description: Comma-separated feature keys to scope the search (e.g. ai-chat,types). Only docs tagged with these features are searched.

params.name: product
params.description: Product to search: `tana` or `outliner`. Defaults to the product of the host you are querying.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Search documentation by text pattern, optionally scoped to feature areas. Returns matching document paths, titles, descriptions, and summaries.

info.name: Read a full page or a specific section as clean markdown

params.name: path
params.description: Document path in the format product/type/slug, using the singular docType key (e.g. tana/feature/ai-chat, outliner/help/getting-started). This is the path returned in search results.

params.name: section
params.description: Heading id to extract a single section (e.g. model-selection). Use "intro" for content before the first heading.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format: markdown (default, MDX stripped) or raw (original MDX source).

items.docs: Read a full documentation page or a specific section as clean markdown.
